interface_document: |
    opencli: 0.1

      title: Calculator CLI

      halve:
        description: Run go run ./services/calc halve [--exact] VALUE from the host root;
          stdout is VALUE halved and a newline. Without --exact the half is rounded
          toward zero and printed as an integer; with --exact an odd VALUE's half is
          printed with one decimal digit.
        parameters:
        - name: exact
          in: flag
          schema:
            type: boolean
        - name: value
          in: argument
          required: true
          schema:
            type: integer
        responses:
          '0':
            description: The half on stdout
          '1':
            description: Invalid arguments
      double:
        description: Run go run ./services/calc double VALUE from the host root; stdout
          is VALUE doubled, as an integer, and a newline.
        parameters:
        - name: value
          in: argument
          required: true
          schema:
            type: integer
        responses:
          '0':
            description: Doubled integer on stdout
          '1':
            description: Invalid arguments

    - function: concept95123e5878d35715c67b1f901cd0d6e1fcafc896021616abdece460efff6ed7e
      file: tests/calc/steps/concept95123e5878d35715c67b1f901cd0d6e1fcafc896021616abdece460efff6ed7e.go
      pattern: ^the calculator's output (matches|does not match) (.+)$
      captures:
        - name: comparison
          means: 'The literal matching word of the step, either "matches" or "does not match": the alternative that decides whether the body requires a match of the pattern against the kept stdout or requires that there be no match.'
        - name: pattern
          means: The rest of the step after the matching word, taken verbatim as the regular expression the kept stdout (without its trailing newline) is matched against, e.g. "^3$", "^12$", "\\." or "^3\\.5$".
      serves: 'The whole does clause: "Match the step''s pattern, a regular expression taken as the rest of the step, against the kept stdout without its trailing newline" is served by the trailing `pattern` capture, and "require a match or, when the step says does not match, no match" is served by the `comparison` capture. The literal words "the calculator''s output" and the matches/does not match alternation make the pattern this concept''s rather than any text, while the free-text tail keeps it general enough for any new regular expression of the same shape.'
      steps:
        - text: the calculator's output matches ^3$
          captures:
            - matches
            - ^3$
        - text: the calculator's output matches ^12$
          captures:
            - matches
            - ^12$
        - text: the calculator's output does not match \.
          captures:
            - does not match
            - \.
        - text: the calculator's output matches ^3\.5$
          captures:
            - matches
            - ^3\.5$

    - id: calc-002-double

        When:
          - the Owner doubles 6
        Then:
          - the calculator's output matches ^12$
    - id: calc-003-halve-odd
      description: Halving an odd number prints a whole number
      service: calc
      path: tests/calc/calc_test.go
      steps: |
        When:
          - the Owner halves 7
        Then:

    - id: calc-004-exact
      description: Halving an odd number exactly keeps its half
      service: calc
      path: tests/calc/calc_test.go
      steps: |
        When:
          - the Owner exactly halves 7
        Then:
          - the calculator's output matches ^3\.5$
